scope: Available AC–RJ 2026 runoff, partial national; all other rounds/history explicit imports

inputs.freeze: Immutable snapshot and coverage ledger; absent until Phase3; live latest mappings do not prove historical mappings
inputs.logs: Original logs/indexes/auxiliaries in available AC–RJ corpus; presence alone is not decoded evidence
inputs.sessions: Validated target official VOTA reconstruction, replacement/copy deduplication, anonymous cycles and uncertainty
inputs.clocks: Evidence-based municipality/overseas rule, adjustments and clock confidence/sensitivity bounds
inputs.bu2: Explicit import of 2026 runoff BU counts, electorate and versions; not supplied by logs
inputs.bu1: Explicit import of 2026 first-round BUs and contest definitions
inputs.composition: Frozen member-to-principal and cross-round harmonization; splits/mergers/transfers accounted for
inputs.locations: Election-scoped polling-place register, geography and TSE/IBGE mapping
inputs.processing: Explicit source receipt/processing/generation/publication timestamps with original values and confidence
inputs.final: Coherent reconciled final BR/UF/municipality results including ZZ; no margin currently asserted
inputs.history: Explicit year/round-specific 2022/2018 results and, where available, comparable logs; not clean labels
inputs.rdv_signatures: Targeted RDV, envelopes, trusted schema/key material and independent verification; transport digest alone insufficient
inputs.corroboration: Independent BU copies, minutes, incidents, occurrence records and access/suppression evidence
inputs.pre_election: Pre-election location, accessibility, logistics and other justified covariates; observation dates recorded
inputs.design: Frozen targets, candidate A/B official identifiers, roles, mechanism variants, splits, seeds and testing families
inputs.calibration: Validated held-out predictions/scores, overlap, scale floors, exchangeability assessment and cluster units
inputs.validation: Documented synthetic/benign mechanisms, full pipeline resampling, held-out history/geography and power/resolution
inputs.mechanism: Corroborated affected population, deduplicated subset/cap and explicit mechanism/counterfactual; otherwise unidentified

features.denominator: Expected registered sections; distinct principal count reported separately
features.definition: Expected/member/principal/installed/not_installed/log/BU/parsed/reconciled/excluded counts; publish unknown strata
unavailable_when: Candidate support needs bu2, otherwise that stratification unavailable

features.denominator: Unique reconstructed sessions; completed cycles for rates
features.definition: Completed/suspended/cancelled/unresolved cycles; manual requests vs completed manual cycles; restarts/outages; selection uncertainty

features.denominator: Completed cycles with valid start/end; within-session adjacent valid cycles for gaps
features.definition: Duration/gap distribution with eligible pair counts; failed authorization per known attempt; outages and within-day intensity per observed exposure seconds

features.grain: snapshot × principal × package/result version × event type
features.denominator: Expected packages/results in declared status population, not number of observed timestamps
features.definition: Separate availability for receipt, processing, generation and publication; missing is not zero latency

features.grain: snapshot × principal × deduplicated selected session population
features.denominator: Completed cycles with classifiable completion instants; separately all completed and unresolved cycles
features.definition: Domestic after17 means completion strictly after 17:00:00 America/Sao_Paulo (Brasilia) on target election date; equal boundary not after. Overseas separately with local convention; never candidate attribution. Store counts, share, last completion, and clock-bound sensitivity

features.denominator: Eligible electorate for turnout; all presidential ballots for blank/null; candidate votes for valid share
features.definition: One canonical eligible totalized result; totals one row per result, long choices separately; reconcile every category

features.denominator: Canonical resolved principal results with total_presidential_ballots > 0; separately counts unavailable
features.definition: Strict unanimity: one candidate has total_presidential_ballots, all other choices zero, blank/null/special/unresolved zero and complete. All-valid-only unanimity is a different separately named statistic

features.grain: snapshot × principal × result version × interval type
features.denominator: Results with both specified event instants known; report missing/out-of-order counts separately
features.definition: Keep receipt, processing, generation, publication, client observation distinct; compute explicitly named intervals without overwriting negative/corrected values; distinguish closing-to-receipt from receipt-to-publication
unavailable_when: Incompatible clocks or unresolved event semantics
Log download time is not transmission

features.denominator: Matched/harmonized electorate or candidate-only valid votes separately for each round
features.definition: Preference vector and turnout differences on equivalent aggregation; candidate IDs/contest counts explicit, changed electorates/transfers retained. No individual vote-transfer inference

features.denominator: Feature-specific denominator and availability, never generic zero imputation
features.definition: Long feature ledger includes value, unit, numerator, denominator, status/reason, source keys, transformation version, role and mechanism-specification membership

features.denominator: Eligible electors > 0 in same population
features.definition: attending_voters / eligible_electors; validated log completions are corroboration, not automatic replacement of official attendance

features.denominator: A + B > 0; all other candidate categories explicitly reconciled
features.definition: A / (A + B); A/B fixed from official candidacy IDs and evaluated symmetrically

features.denominator: total_presidential_ballots > 0 including all applicable categories
features.definition: Separate blank and applicable null proportions; exceptional categories separately identified, not silently merged

features.grain: harmonized principal × versioned pre-specified peer definition
features.denominator: Comparable population/overlap; source observation dates for covariates
features.definition: Electorate/size, first-round vector, geography, comparable history, pre-election polling-place characteristics, contest count; current-cycle-only/no-first-round sensitivity variants

features.denominator: Known hardware/software/logistics exposure and observed sessions
features.definition: Model/version/logistics adjust one operational specification and are possible mechanisms in another; turnout/manual/outages remain outcomes/exposures when hypothesized effects
unavailable_when: Role would condition away proposed effect

features.denominator: Same coherent principal population and canonical versions at every hierarchy
features.definition: Accounting and BR/UF/municipality incl ZZ checks; targeted RDV recount/signatures; distinguish publication gaps, numerical disagreement and independent corroboration
unavailable_when: Missing independent records or final population
Partial AC–RJ cannot establish national reconciliation

features.denominator: Eligible held-out peers/calibration clusters; record n_cal and overlap
features.definition: Matched empirical median/quantiles/MAD and quantile regression forest compared by held-out quantile loss/coverage; signed residuals plus prespecified joint maximum score with trained scale floors
unavailable_when: Unsupported exchangeability yields descriptive tail ranks only

features.denominator: Full prespecified tested family incl null results; valid p-values required
features.definition: Whole-location splits/seeds/geographic strata; municipality stress tests; dependence-aware BY at proposed 5% FDR; retain adaptive/exploratory ledger and test-set access history
unavailable_when: Adaptive search or monitoring not covered by fixed family

features.grain: mechanism × magnitude × geographic concentration / investigated case
features.denominator: All simulated cases plus random unflagged sample; stratum coverage
features.definition: Independent validation copies for additions/switches/turnout reduction/duplicates/missing blocks/clock errors; power/localization/benign false alarms; initially candidate-blinded log review where feasible

features.denominator: r completed presidential ballots with 0 <= r <= a + b + c; validated q_i caps; reconciled M
features.definition: Anonymous-removal sharp bounds; at-most-r includes zero; switching cap 2 * min(q_i, a_i); strict-win thresholds floor(M/2) + 1 or M + 1; no allocation of anonymous cycles to candidates
unavailable_when: r counts attempts instead of ballots
National impact unidentified outside affected population

features.denominator: n_valid_i with fixed valid turnout; absent-voter preference assumptions separate
features.definition: Excess relative to baseline: 2 * sum(a_i - n_valid_i * p_hat_i); full fit/selection pipeline geographic block resampling and sensitivity; signed effects not stolen votes
unavailable_when: Section intervals cannot be summed as national confidence interval

rules: Missing observations are never numerical zero.
Every requested unit remains in coverage/readiness ledger, including unavailable and excluded units.
Readiness is evaluated per feature and unit after validated inputs; this registry does not certify data availability.
No fitting, fraud labeling, candidate attribution of anonymous cycles, or national inference from partial collection.
